# FDN Armasaur Guide: "Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on
# target creature you control."  M21 Tide Skimmer's B2b-attack-two-flying-draw (verified): the
# count is a conjunct of the DeclareAttackersEvent filter (CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 3 over your
# attacking creatures), once per declaration (once_per_event); M21 Feat of Resistance's counter on
# target creature you control.
lead = TriggeredAbility(
    event=DeclareAttackersEvent(
        filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FAtom(
                    pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
                    count=QConst(value=3),
                    inner_filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ATTACKING),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
    once_per_event=True,
)
abilities = [lead, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

mapping.notes: Tide Skimmer's 'attack with N or more' (CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 3 over your attacking creatures in the DeclareAttackersEvent filter, once_per_event); Feat of Resistance's counter on target creature you control. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/armasaur_guide_three_attackers_put_a_counter.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/armasaur_guide_two_attackers_no_counter.json.
